title: CY50110: Techniques For Organic Synthesis
text:

Pre-requisite: Nil;Phase transfer reactions, reactions with solid supported

use of microwave, flash vacuum pyrolysis, electroorganic transformations,
enzymatic processes, reactions in ionic liquids, green technologies.Book:
